players.name: Jeremy McNichols

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.note: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tim Patrick
players.note: The Jets designated Patrick (groin) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, John Pullano of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Andy Dalton
players.note: Dalton is expected to serve as the Eagles' No. 3 quarterback for Sunday's game against the Rams, while Tanner McKee moves up to second on the depth chart as the top backup to Jalen Hurts, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Case Keenum
players.note: Keenum is expected to remain in a backup role for Sunday's game against the Packers after head coach Ben Johnson said that Tyson Bagent will start at quarterback in Week 5, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

players.name: Zach Wilson
players.note: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Saints' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's contest against the Falcons.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson rushed four times for 16 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He added one catch for seven yards on one target.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.note: Mallory (thumb) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

players.name: Scott Matlock
players.note: The Chargers opened Matlock's (undisclosed) 21-day practice window Monday, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.note: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday.

players.name: Irv Charles

players.name: David Martin-Robinson
players.note: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday.

players.name: Trevor Etienne
players.note: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
